mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMP_INDEX_RESULT (emp_id, data_date, version, val_${slot}) VALUES (#{empId}, #{dataDate}, #{version}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE val_${slot} = VALUES(val_${slot}), updated_time = NOW()
INSERT INTO EMP_INDEX_RESULT (emp_id, data_date, version) VALUES (#{empId}, #{dataDate}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT emp_id FROM EMP_INDEX_RESULT WHERE data_date = #{dataDate} ORDER BY emp_id

SELECT id, data_date AS dataDate, version, emp_id AS empId, created_time AS createdTime, updated_time AS updatedTime FROM EMP_INDEX_RESULT WHERE emp_id = #{empId} AND data_date <= #{today} ORDER BY data_date DESC, updated_time DESC, version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT metric_code AS metricCode, val_slot AS valSlot FROM PERF_METRIC_DEF WHERE val_slot IS NOT NULL AND metric_code IN #{c}

SELECT t.emp_id AS subjectId, t.val_${slot} AS value FROM EMP_INDEX_RESULT t JOIN ( SELECT emp_id, MAX(updated_time) AS mt FROM EMP_INDEX_RESULT WHERE data_date = #{dataDate} GROUP BY emp_id ) m ON t.emp_id = m.emp_id AND t.updated_time = m.mt WHERE t.data_date = #{dataDate} AND t.val_${slot} IS NOT NULL
